reviews.body:
Appreciate you bringing `stopReason` over from #1920. Non-streamed Bedrock calls now report `stop`/`length` on this branch, but a streamed Bedrock response still ends with `finishReason` undefined: `@langchain/aws` passes the `messageStop` event into `response_metadata` unchanged, so the key sits one level down.

```
{"messageStop":{"stopReason":"end_turn"}}
{"metadata":{"usage":{"inputTokens":10,"outputTokens":16,"totalTokens":26},"metrics":{"latencyMs":361}},"model_provider":"bedrock-converse"}
```

Python's langchain-aws flattens that event, which is why the flat lookup was enough in #1920. The two inline suggestions read the nested key and add a test row for it. Live `ChatBedrockConverse` through `LangChainChatModel.create()`, Haiku 4.5 in us-east-1:

| request | main | this PR | with suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| invoke | `stop` | `stop` | `stop` |
| invoke, `maxTokens: 8` | `stop` | `length` | `length` |
| stream | `stop` | `undefined` | `stop` |
| stream, `maxTokens: 8` | `stop` | `undefined` | `length` |

The stream rows also need your `merge` change. The usage chunk arrives after `messageStop`, and with the suggestion on top of main's `merge` both stream rows go back to `undefined`.

I ran this on main ba1a76e and beacf49 with `@langchain/aws` 1.4.3, the newest release that accepts the repo's `@langchain/core` 1.1.49, and the last two columns come out the same with 1.5.2 on core 1.4.1. Your test against main's source is 12 failed / 3 passed, and 15 passed here. With the extra row it's 1 failed on this branch and 16 passed with the suggestion. ESLint, Prettier and `tsc --noEmit` are clean with it applied.

Thanks, and thanks @kimnamu for the Bedrock note. The finish reason is now read from provider metadata, and the `ChatModelOutput.merge` change keeps it through the trailing usage chunk. I pushed two mechanical fixes: I squashed and reworded the commit so commitlint passes (the scope `langchain` isn't allowed, and a body line was over 100 characters), and moved the test to `src/adapters/langchain/backend/chat.test.ts`, because CI only runs tests under `src/`.

review_comments.body:
Row for the streamed shape. It fails on this branch (`expected undefined to be 'length'`) and passes with the suggestion above.

```suggestion
    [{ stopReason: "tool_use" }, "tool-calls"],
    [{ messageStop: { stopReason: "max_tokens" } }, "length"],
```

comments.body:
Applied both suggestions: the adapter now reads `messageStop.stopReason`, and the test table includes the streamed `max_tokens` shape. The new case fails before the fix and all 16 cases pass with it. Prettier, ESLint and `tsc --noEmit` also pass.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
